packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

PACKET-11 - blind image reading (unverified)

Exposure statement: Nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or reading of this fragment. I opened only PROMPT.md and the image files in this packet (and listed the directory); I did not read packet.json. Pencil notes on the leaf itself: "aus Einband II/G 36 (a 1534)" and "Stams, STA, Frg. 28r" / "28v". Disclosure: while reading, the dialogue felt familiar to me (a Latin verse/prose dialogue with speaker sigla). I have tried not to let that fill gaps: where letters are not clearly visible I mark them, and I have not supplied missing words. A checker should treat smooth-looking stretches with some suspicion of memory influence and verify letter by letter.

== LAYOUT SURVEY ==

Images: image-001 = reduced overview, face 28r; image-002..005 = native tiles (002 upper left, 003 upper right, 004 lower left, 005 lower right). image-006 = reduced overview, face 28v; image-007..010 = native tiles (007 upper left, 008 upper right, 009 lower left, 010 lower right).

Observations:
- Small paper or thin parchment leaf (c. 18 x 14 cm by the scale), landscape, folded vertically down the middle; text in two columns, one each side of the fold (most likely two pages of a bifolium or a folded leaf, so "column" order across the fold is uncertain). c. 14-16 lines per column.
- Single hand, brown ink, a cursive humanistic/Gothic-mixed hand with long descenders and looped ascenders; not a formal book hand. No rubrication.
- Text is a dialogue: lines contain speaker sigla (single capitals followed by a point: "S.", "C.", "M.", "D.") separating speeches.
- Scene-heading lines listing names in larger letters: 28r col b "Cremes senex  Slyses? Ancila  Da[...]"; 28v col b "Simo  Chremes senex".
- Each scene heading is followed by a pen-drawn enlarged initial: on 28r col b an R combined with a drawn bearded human head in a turban/cap, with foliage; on 28v col b an initial (L or I?) with a small drawn head/bird and foliage. A further drawn turbaned head appears in the gutter of 28r (image-002 right edge = same drawing as on image-003).
- Several strikethrough deletions in the text (noted below).
- 28r col b upper right corner torn; 28v col a upper left corner torn and folded; 28v col b lower half faded and blotched.

Selected spans: all lines of both columns on both faces. Unread portions are the torn corners and the faded lower 28v col b, marked below.

Conventions: (abc) = proposed expansion; word? = uncertain; [illegible]; [torn] = loss at tear. Line numbers counted from the first text line of each tile. Overlaps between tiles are noted as "= previous line".
